AnalysisFactsV1.description: checks/captures describe the played move. material_delta is material gained by the mover on this move using pawn=100, knight=320, bishop=330, rook=500, queen=900; it is not an engine evaluation. Motifs are limited to facts the v1 verifier can prove.

AnalysisJobV1.description: Postgres durable job snapshot; Redis enqueue is not completion. Every worker/result read repeats participant, phase, revision and position_key checks. A stale result cannot become current.

AnalysisReadyEventV1.description: Durable event: seq is allocated atomically with game state/outbox. Publish only after commit.

AnalysisRequestV1.description: Participant-scoped analysis of a server-reconstructed move. Idempotency-Key UUIDv4 header required; no client FEN, scores, engine paths or free resource budgets. Server captures revision/position_key when accepting the request.

AnalysisResultV1.description: Engine facts only; no coach prose. position_key = sha256(before_fen + "|" + played_move_uci). Replay the played move to after_fen and each candidate PV from before_fen. cp_loss = max(0, (score_before.value - score_after.value) * (1 for a white mover, -1 for black)), only when both scores are cp. No public arbitrary-FEN endpoint.

CapabilitiesV1.description: Server-computed, viewer-specific permissions; not an authorization credential.

CoachReadyEventV1.description: Durable event: seq is allocated atomically with game state/outbox. Publish only after commit.

CreateGameV1.description: Public create command. rated is created only by matchmaking. Idempotency-Key: UUIDv4 header is mandatory; no client FEN, clock state, result, engine budget or binary path.

EngineLimitsV1.description: Effective server-selected worker limits. At least one non-null bound. These fields are metadata, never accepted from a public analysis request.

FenV1.description: Standard chess FEN; six fields, legal board, canonical python-chess Board.fen(). History is carried by moves, not by FEN.

GameActionV1.description: Versioned resign or draw action. Idempotency-Key UUIDv4 and CSRF headers are required.

GameClockSyncEventV1.description: Durable event: seq is allocated atomically with game state/outbox. Publish only after commit.

GameEventV1.description: Read-only server-to-client stream. Discriminate by type before consuming payload; unknown event types fail validation. Snapshot/resync control frames carry a cursor but are handled separately from durable event dedup. Matchmaking has REST polling, not a game stream event.

GameMoveCommittedEventV1.description: Durable event: seq is allocated atomically with game state/outbox. Publish only after commit.

GameSnapshotEventV1.description: Control frame: seq is the current committed game cursor; does not allocate a durable event sequence.

GameSnapshotV1.description: Full current branch, from the standard initial position. version changes per accepted command; revision changes on takeback. moves are contiguous and replay to fen/ply/side_to_move. Old branches remain in server audit storage. Permissions depend on requesting actor.

GameStatusChangedEventV1.description: Durable event: seq is allocated atomically with game state/outbox. Publish only after commit.

GameTakebackAppliedEventV1.description: Durable event: seq is allocated atomically with game state/outbox. Publish only after commit.

MoveAcceptedV1.description: Persisted response returned identically on retry with the same actor/client_move_id and payload. snapshot.version = expected_version + 1. The move equals the last snapshot.moves item. Reuse with another payload gives 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

ResyncRequiredEventV1.description: Control frame: seq is the current committed game cursor; does not allocate a durable event sequence.

ScoreV1.description: White POV always. cp is centipawns; mate is signed UCI mate distance in moves. Mate zero is a terminal position: the board identifies the mated side. Never convert a mate score to centipawns.

TakebackV1.description: Solo only. plies is explicit: UI sends 2 for a complete human/engine cycle, or 1 while engine reply is pending. Never valid for friend/rated.

TopMoveV1.description: Ranked at before_fen from the mover POV; uci is the first PV move and san is its SAN at before_fen. Replay every PV for legality.

VerifiedClaimV1.description: Only mechanically verifiable claims about the played move. Free text, engine-generated motives and unverified threats are outside this v1 vocabulary.
